guitar.guitaristsText: Mick Ronson / Carlos Alomar / Earl Slick
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Ronson) / Fender Stratocaster / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Bowie used many different guitarists across eras with no single signature instrument tied to Bowie himself; medium is appropriate given Ronson's well-known Les Paul.

tone.target: lush orchestral clean with subtle shimmer
tone.profile: lush orchestral clean with subtle shimmer
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing light compression and a classic Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with a bright cab. Subtle reverb and delay add the required 'lush orchestral' shimmer without sounding overly processed or jangling.
corrections: Remove chorus as the main effect
Aim for delicate, supportive guitar under piano
